notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Axebane Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Axebane Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
